name: Halo CE
description: Halo: Combat Evolved for the PS Vita (decomp port)
long_description: A native PlayStation Vita port of Halo: Combat Evolved, built from the decompilation of the Xbox game. It is not an emulator: the game's own code is compiled for the Vita's ARM processor, and its Direct3D rendering is translated to the Vita's GPU.
requirements:
- A PS Vita or PS TV with HENkaku/Ensō (firmware 3.60 to 3.74) and VitaShell.
- About 1.5 GB free on ux0: (the game keeps decompressed copies of the levels it loads).
- Your own Xbox copy of Halo: Combat Evolved (the disc, or an image of it). All versions of the Xbox game work. The PC version's maps do not.
